# rn-router-ios (iOS 27.2) ground-truth fixtures

Expo Router apps in **Expo Go 58.0.7** on the iPhone 18 Pro simulator, iOS 27.2: the 9 states and taps of
`../../rn-router-ios/README.md` (`tabs-*`: `examples/expo-default`, Metro 8130; `stack-*`: `examples/expo-router-stack`, Metro 8131).
Each state relaunches Expo Go and opens `exp://127.0.0.1:PORT?__expo_disable_fab=1&__expo_disable_auto_launch=1&__expo_disable_onboarding=1`
with Expo Go in front (no status-bar back-link).
